name: brand-identity-tournament
description: Two designers on different model families draw competing logo concepts from one brief; a judge scores them against the product's design profile; the conductor runs revision rounds and stops at a human gate before anything is promoted.

product.description: Product slug matching profiles/<product>/ in the design-system repo (e.g. vault, gateway, capture)

design_system.description: Absolute path to the design-system checkout

max_rounds.description: Maximum revision rounds after the first judgement

agents.instructions: Product under design: {{inputs.product}}. The brief you send comes from the brand-brief skill and must quote the product profile's palette roles and bans verbatim. Both designers receive the identical brief file. After the judge accepts, stop at the human gate and present the winner with the scorecard; do not promote anything into assets/ or catalog.json yourself.
Produce {{inputs.concepts}} concepts per brief. Each from a different strategy (lettermark, abstract mark, pictorial mark unless the brief says otherwise).
Produce {{inputs.concepts}} concepts per brief. Each from a different strategy (lettermark, abstract mark, pictorial mark unless the brief says otherwise).
Score against the brand-judge rubric and the product profile. Disqualify any concept that violates a listed ban before scoring.

workflow.description: Conductor writes one brief from the product profile with the brand-brief skill and sends the same file to both designers.
Designers deliver SVG concept sets with rationales into artifacts/<designer>/<message-id>/.
Conductor forwards the brief plus every concept path to the judge; judge returns a scorecard with one verdict.
Only the candidates the judge named are revised, with the numbered fixes; then back to the judge stage.

gates.description: Operator reviews the accepted concept and scorecard before any promotion into the canonical asset tree.

artifacts.promote_to: Use the design-system-assets skill to import the approved files into assets/products/{{inputs.product}}/ with catalog provenance; keep every round under artifacts/ as decision evidence.
